name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
What's new since v3.48.1

🛠 Empty write requests are refused (3.49.1) — a calendar write without the list of years no longer wipes the project calendar (calendar_invalid), and a history write without the history key is refused instead of answering success without a write. No schema change.

🔌 External REST for integrations and agents (3.49.0) — an OpenAPI 3.1 contract for 43 operations ships in the repository (Integrations/openapi-sprint.yaml): sprint, history, capacity, calendar and absences, releases, reminders. Every refusal now carries a machine-readable reason and a request id cid; 11 small operations let an agent make one change instead of a full replace (upsertItem, assignPerson, upsertAbsence, setReleaseStatus and more). baseRev is now required for history, releases and absences. No schema change.

🛠 Gantt listed for Hierarchy links (3.48.3) — the “Used by” column in the Issue links settings now shows a Gantt badge for the Hierarchy role, which drives epic groups in the “All roles” Gantt mode. No schema change.

🛠 Re-running the cross-role forecast gives the same dates (3.48.2) — in the “All roles” Gantt mode each person’s queue follows issue priority instead of the issues’ current dates, so a second forecast with unchanged data no longer reorders issues. No schema change.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles and issue fields, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
